definition: Task decomposition here means splitting a single reasoning problem into ordered sub-stages rather than solving it in one pass. DR²Seg splits reasoning segmentation into a description stage and a referring-segmentation stage, rewarding shorter descriptions that still yield the correct mask; D-CORE instead names inadequate task decomposition 'Lazy Reasoning', a failure mode in complex tool-use settings that its self-distillation-then-diversity-aware-RL recipe is designed to correct.

evidence.note: DR2Seg splits reasoning segmentation into a description stage and a referring-segmentation stage and rewards the model when a shorter self-contained description still yields the right mask, cutting reasoning length while raising gIoU.
evidence.title: DR$^2$Seg: Decomposed Two-Stage Rollouts for Efficient Reasoning Segmentation in Multimodal Large Language Models

evidence.note: Trains large reasoning models with self-distillation followed by diversity-aware RL to overcome 'Lazy Reasoning' -- inadequate task decomposition -- in complex tool-use settings.
evidence.title: D-CORE: Incentivizing Task Decomposition in Large Reasoning Models for Complex Tool Use

name: task decomposition
